entries.title: Exaltation (uccha)
entries.body: An exalted graha is at its strongest classical sign dignity and can deliver its good significations fully. Expression still depends on the house, aspects, combustion and the rest of the chart. Exaltation does not make a planet's hard lessons disappear; it gives the resources to meet them.

entries.title: Own sign (svakshetra)
entries.body: A graha in its own sign acts with confidence and self-sufficiency, like a person at home. Its results are reliable and stable, and the houses it rules are protected.

entries.title: Friendly sign
entries.body: A graha in the sign of a natural friend is comfortable and cooperative. It produces moderately good results, supported by its dispositor.

entries.title: Neutral sign
entries.body: A graha in a neutral sign gives neither added strength nor weakness from its sign. Its results depend chiefly on house, aspects and conjunctions.

entries.title: Enemy sign
entries.body: A graha in the sign of a natural enemy works with some friction, like a guest in an unwelcoming house. Its results may come with effort or compromise, and a strong dispositor or benefic aspects help.

entries.title: Debilitation (neecha)
entries.body: A debilitated graha is at its weakest sign dignity. Its significations may need conscious effort, or may come late or in unusual forms. Classical texts give many conditions for cancellation (neecha bhanga), after which the planet can give strong results after early struggle.

entries.title: Exalted Sun
entries.body: The Sun exalted in Mesha brings strong vitality, confidence, leadership and recognition, with good relations with authority when otherwise supported. Pride and impatience are the risks of excess.

entries.title: Sun in its own sign
entries.body: The Sun in Simha is dignified. It gives natural authority, generosity and creative self-expression, with steady self-esteem and leadership.

entries.title: Debilitated Sun
entries.body: The Sun in Tula is debilitated. Self-assertion yields to diplomacy and partnership, and confidence or relations with the father and authority may need work. It can mature into fair, cooperative leadership, especially with neecha bhanga.

entries.title: Exalted Moon
entries.body: The Moon exalted in Vrishabha gives emotional stability, contentment, a pleasant nature and material comfort. It is classically one of the most fortunate conditions for peace of mind.

entries.title: Moon in its own sign
entries.body: The Moon in Karka is at home. It gives nurturing instincts, intuition and emotional depth, with strong attachment to family and home.

entries.title: Debilitated Moon
entries.body: The Moon in Vrishchika is debilitated. Feelings are intense and private, and the mind can be prone to worry or turbulence. It also gives psychological depth and resilience, and supportive aspects or neecha bhanga ease it considerably.

entries.title: Exalted Mars
entries.body: Mars exalted in Makara gives disciplined, effective energy, strategic courage and great capacity for sustained work and command.

entries.title: Mars in its own sign
entries.body: Mars in Mesha or Vrishchika is strong. It gives courage, initiative and resilience. In Mesha it is direct; in Vrishchika it is strategic and intense.

entries.title: Debilitated Mars
entries.body: Mars in Karka is debilitated. Action is coloured by emotion, and anger may be suppressed or come out indirectly. It can express as fierce protectiveness of home and family. With neecha bhanga it becomes a source of strength.

entries.title: Exalted Mercury
entries.body: Mercury exalted in Kanya gives analytical excellence, precision, skill with language, accounts and science, and practical intelligence.

entries.title: Mercury in its own sign
entries.body: Mercury in Mithuna or Kanya is strong. It gives quick intelligence, skill in communication and trade, and adaptability.

entries.title: Debilitated Mercury
entries.body: Mercury in Meena is debilitated. Logic yields to intuition and imagination, which is excellent for poetry and spirituality but harder for precise detail. A strong Jupiter or neecha bhanga helps.

entries.title: Exalted Jupiter
entries.body: Jupiter exalted in Karka gives wisdom, compassion, protection, prosperity and devotion. It is classically among the most beneficial conditions in a chart.

entries.title: Jupiter in its own sign
entries.body: Jupiter in Dhanu or Meena is strong. It gives wisdom, generosity, faith and good fortune, and supports the houses it rules.

entries.title: Debilitated Jupiter
entries.body: Jupiter in Makara is debilitated. Faith and optimism meet practical demands, and wisdom becomes pragmatic. Guidance may come late or from unexpected sources. Neecha bhanga can make it a builder of lasting institutions.

entries.title: Exalted Venus
entries.body: Venus exalted in Meena gives selfless love, artistic and musical refinement, devotion and happiness in relationships.

entries.title: Venus in its own sign
entries.body: Venus in Vrishabha or Tula is strong. It gives comfort, beauty, harmony and happiness in relationships, and supports wealth and the arts.

entries.title: Debilitated Venus
entries.body: Venus in Kanya is debilitated. Affection is shown through service and discernment rather than romance, and fulfilment in love may need patience. It gives skill in crafts and healing. Neecha bhanga eases it.

entries.title: Exalted Saturn
entries.body: Saturn exalted in Tula gives justice, fairness, discipline and lasting achievement through balanced effort. It is classically among Saturn's finest conditions.

entries.title: Saturn in its own sign
entries.body: Saturn in Makara or Kumbha is strong. It gives patience, organisational ability, endurance and a steady rise through work.

entries.title: Debilitated Saturn
entries.body: Saturn in Mesha is debilitated. Patience clashes with impulse, bringing frustration or conflict with authority. Discipline learned through experience becomes real strength, especially with neecha bhanga.

entries.title: Combust Moon
entries.body: The Moon close to the Sun is near the new moon (amavasya). Classically the Moon is weak in pakshabala then, and the mind may feel less buoyant or more inward. It is an introspective condition, and care for rest and emotional support is advised.

entries.title: Combust Mars
entries.body: Mars within the Sun's orb loses independent expression. Energy and assertion are absorbed by the Sun's agenda, sometimes as frustration or heat, and Mars's significations need conscious channelling.

entries.title: Combust Mercury
entries.body: Mercury is combust very often because it never strays far from the Sun. Classically its independent judgement is overshadowed by the ego, so thinking serves identity. Many traditions soften this for Mercury, and deep combustion within a few degrees matters most.

entries.title: Combust Jupiter
entries.body: Jupiter within the Sun's orb has its wisdom and blessings partly eclipsed. Guidance, faith or teachers may be less visible, and the houses Jupiter rules may need extra support.

entries.title: Combust Venus
entries.body: Venus within the Sun's orb has comfort, affection and artistic expression subordinated to the ego or to duty. Relationships and pleasures may need conscious space.

entries.title: Combust Saturn
entries.body: Saturn within the Sun's orb brings the natural tension between the two into focus. Authority and duty clash, relations with the father or superiors may be strained, and Saturn's endurance is tested.

entries.title: Retrograde Mars
entries.body: Retrograde Mars is classically strong (chesta bala) but turns its energy inward. Action is revisited, repeated or delayed, and old conflicts can resurface. Strategic reconsideration before acting is its gift.

entries.title: Retrograde Mercury
entries.body: Retrograde Mercury gives a reflective, non-linear and original mind that revisits ideas and learns deeply on the second pass. Communication benefits from review, and intuitive leaps are common.

entries.title: Retrograde Jupiter
entries.body: Retrograde Jupiter gives an internalised, independent philosophy and wisdom developed through re-examining inherited beliefs. Its blessings may come after reflection or later in life.

entries.title: Retrograde Venus
entries.body: Retrograde Venus gives an unconventional or deeply reflective approach to love, values and beauty. Past relationships may be revisited, and taste is individual.

entries.title: Retrograde Saturn
entries.body: Retrograde Saturn internalises discipline and responsibility, often as an inner critic. Karmic lessons are revisited until mastered, and it gives great persistence once the lessons are understood.
